fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects active directory enumeration activity using known AdFind CLI flags
fields.name: PUA - Suspicious ActiveDirectory Enumeration Via AdFind.EXE
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "lockoutduration" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "lockoutthreshold" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "lockoutobservationwindow" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "maxpwdage" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "minpwdage" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "minpwdlength" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "pwdhistorylength" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "pwdproperties") or tgt.process.cmdline contains "-sc admincountdmp" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "-sc exchaddresses"))
